name: smwmusic-pok-mon-ruby-sapphire-emerald-hideout
title: Pokémon Ruby/Sapphire/Emerald - Hideout
description:
Either it's Team Magma or Team Aqua. It depends on the version of the game. Anyway, this theme is groovy. Best used for modern looking levels. I guess it can work for castles too since this theme is originally heard when inside the antagonist's hideout.

UPDATES: Swapped a few channels around. Fixed the @21s randomly changing pitch. Tacked on $F4 $02 to make this sound way better than the previous 2 versions. Fixed the @3 that played on channel 8, which was an entire octave lower than intended.
